notes.title: In regard to HAMMER WORLD’s development status
notes.content:
It has been several years since the last communication, but I would like to update everyone on HAMMER WORLD’s status. 
Unfortunately, due to development issues, the project is indefinitely frozen.
I am sorry to give this disappointing announcement to those of you who were looking forward to its release.
I would still like to re-challenge the 3D metroidvania genre at some point in the future.

In other news…
NEO FUTURE LABS has just released the new game [b]“BURGER IMPACT: SOLAR STRIKE”[/b] on April 28, 2023, through Steam Early Access!
If you are interested in surreal physics-based 3D action games where the main character is a hamburger that flies through outer space and engages in “realtime 3d billiards action”, please consider purchasing the game or adding it to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126940/BURGER_IMPACT_SOLAR_STRIKE/

notes.title: We will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2018!
notes.content:
HAMMER WORLD: DIMENSION TRAVELER will be exhibited for the first time at Tokyo Game Show 2018!

The first area of the game (and the one featured in the teaser trailer), the "Mushroom World" will be playable. Come check it out!

- Location: Makuhari Messe
- Dates: Sept 20-23
- Booth: Hall 9, B05
